mapper.sql: select defect_id, defect_code, defect_name, defect_type, defect_level, process_name, status, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from qc_defect
mapper.insert: insert into qc_defect (defect_code, defect_name, defect_type, defect_level, process_name, status, remark, create_by, create_time) values (#{defectCode}, #{defectName}, #{defectType}, #{defectLevel}, #{processName}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update qc_defect set status = #{status}, update_time = sysdate() where defect_id = #{defectId}
